items.name: Auto-Cycle Union (ACU)
items.notes: Primary GB governing body for motorcycle sport including road race, trials, motocross and enduro. England and Wales centres. FIM affiliate.

items.name: Scottish Auto-Cycle Union (SACU)
items.notes: Governing body for motorcycle sport in Scotland. FIM affiliate via ACU.

items.name: Motor Cycle Union of Ireland (MCUI)
items.notes: Ulster Centre covers Northern Ireland road racing (short circuits and public-road events). Separate road-race regulations apply for public-road events.

items.name: ACU Cymru — Wales Centres
items.notes: Welsh ACU centres administer club racing under ACU Standing Regulations; Anglesey Circuit is primary Welsh road-race venue.

items.name: Motor Cycle Road Racing Control Board (MCRCB)
items.notes: Governs the British Superbike Championship and support classes under delegation from the ACU. Sets technical and sporting regulations for BSB.

items.name: Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme (FIM)
items.notes: World governing body; ACU is the FIM affiliate for Great Britain. FIM licence required for international events.

items.name: ACM — Auto-Cycle Club of the Isle of Man
items.notes: Organises the Isle of Man TT and Manx Grand Prix under IOM Government / ACU oversight.
